name: MKT_IMP_VENDORS
description: This interface table stores staging data for the marketing vendors.  The data gets populated into MKT_TM_VENDORS table. A marketing vendor is a third-party company that performs some defined work items as part of the overall business process e.g campaign fulfilment processes.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Primary Key - Batch Identifier. Identifier that groups records into a batch

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Primary Key -  Interface Row ID. Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the status of the record being processed.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the operation to be performed on a row, such as Insert, Update etc.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File Record Number. Record indicator in the File.

columns.name: VENDOR_EXT_REF
columns.description: Vendor Original System Reference. Stored the unique identifier of the vendor in the source system. Used to lookup VENDOR_ID. Maps to MKT_TM_VENDORS.VENDOR_CODE in the Fusion Base table.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: VENDOR_NAME
columns.description: Vendor Name for this vendor record

columns.name: VENDOR_ADDRESS1

columns.name: CONTACT_EMAIL_ADDRESS

columns.name: VENDOR_ID

columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
